common:generalComment.#text: Powder coating is a type of coating applied as a free-flowing, dry powder and cured by heat or ultraviolet light. It is used for coating metals, plastics, carbon fiber, and other materials. The process includes preparation, application, and curing stages. It produces a tough finish able to withstand extreme weather conditions while resisting fading and cracking. It is applied to a charged surface, creating a thicker coating in one application more than a single coat of paint.
粉末涂料是一种以自由流动的干粉形式施加并通过热量或紫外线光固化的涂料。它用于涂覆金属、塑料、碳纤维和其他材料。该过程包括准备、应用和固化阶段。它能产生一种能够抵御极端天气条件的坚韧表面，同时抵抗褪色和开裂。它被施加到一个带电的表面，一次应用就能产生比一层油漆更厚的涂层。

common:generalComment.#text: Polyvinyl acetate is a synthetic resin prepared by the polymerization of vinyl acetate. It serves as the film-forming ingredient in water-based paints and is also used in adhesives. It is most widely used as an emulsion of PVAc polymers in water, formed by polymerization in water of vinyl monomers, predominantly vinyl acetate. It is white to off-white in color and is the familiar 'white glue' used in many households.
聚醋酸乙烯酯是一种由醋酸乙烯聚合而成的合成树脂。它是水性涂料的成膜成分，也可用于粘合剂。它最广泛的用途是作为 PVAc 聚合物在水中的乳液，由乙烯基单体（主要是醋酸乙烯）在水中聚合而成。它呈白色至类白色，是许多家庭熟悉的 "白胶"。

common:generalComment.#text: Wood top-coat is essential for ensuring that wood projects not only last, but also come out looking the way you want. There are both water-based and oil-based topcoats. Water-Based Top Coats have a few advantages. Velvet Finishes topcoat, called Protect, is a polyurethane that is non-yellowing and water-based. The best clear wood finishes will apply easily, provide years of durability and not yellow wood over time.
木材面漆对于确保木材项目不仅经久耐用，而且外观如你所愿至关重要。面漆有水性和油性两种。水性面漆有几个优点。Velvet Finishes 面漆名为 "保护"，是一种不泛黄的水性聚氨酯。最好的透明木器漆涂抹方便，经久耐用，而且不会随着时间的推移而使木材变黄。

common:generalComment.#text: Sawdust is a byproduct of the lumber industry, created when wood is cut or milled into lumber. It comprises tiny wood particles ranging from fine dust to small chips. Commonly used as a fuel source, sawdust can also serve as a soil amendment. It is particularly beneficial for low-pH crops like blueberries, strawberries, and raspberries, acting as an inexpensive mulch option. Sawdust's powdery texture and light brown or gray color result from the sawing, sanding, or grinding of wood during processing.
木屑是木材工业的副产品，是在木材被切割或研磨成木材时产生的。它由细小的木屑颗粒组成，从细小的灰尘到细小的碎屑。木屑通常用作燃料来源，也可以用作土壤改良剂。它对蓝莓、草莓和树莓等低pH作物特别有益，是一种廉价的覆盖物。木屑的粉状质地和浅棕色或灰色是在加工过程中锯切、打磨或研磨木材产生的。
